Strategy: Apply the sweet-band reward between thirty and forty-five only to bins that are at least twice the item size before placement, keeping the mid penalty always on. This targets roomy bins that stay useful after placement, but the gate may rarely engage and the threshold is a guess.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r >= 2 * item and r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
